description_en: Enables or modifies the audit log settings of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 开启或修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的审计日志设置
name: ModifyAuditLogConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which audit logs are retained. Valid values: 1 to 365.
This parameter is required when DbAudit is set to true.
This parameter takes effect on all instances in the current region
parameters.help_zh:
审计日志保留天数，取值：1~365。
当DbAudit取值为true时，本参数必须传入。
本参数的设置对当前地域下的所有实例生效
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable audit logging. Valid values:
true (default): Enabled.
false: Disabled.

If the instance uses the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62870.html, audit logs for data nodes and proxy nodes are enabled or disabled at the same time. You cannot enable them separately
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启审计日志，取值：
true：默认值，开启。
false：关闭。

当实例为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62870.html时，会同时开启或关闭数据节点和代理节点的审计日志，不支持单独开启
parameters.name: db_audit
